% Source: TeX Live 2025 tkz-euclide manual, TKZdoc-euclide-filling.tex
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tkz-euclide}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \tkzDefPoints{0/0/O,3/0/A,0/3/B,-3/0/C,0/-3/D}
  \tkzFillAngle[size=1.5,fill=blue!20,opacity=.5](A,O,B)
  \tkzFillAngles[size=.75,fill=red!20,opacity=.25,draw=red](B,O,C C,O,D)
  \tkzDrawSegments(A,O O,B B,O O,C C,O O,D D,O)
  \tkzDrawPoints(A,B,C,D,O)
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
